data.name: Definitely A Unicorn
data.detailed_description:
Definitely a Unicorn is a co-op startup management sim where you and your friends try to turn a rough idea into a successful tech company. Make decisions together, argue over priorities, survive deadlines, handle crises, and push the business forward before burnout, chaos, and your own brilliant mistakes catch up with you.

What to expect:

  • Co-op startup chaos
    Every player is a co-founder. Share responsibility, react to events, and make calls before someone else beats you to it.

  • Pitches, investors, and deadlines
    Prepare for key meetings, impress investors, and deal with high-pressure moments that can shape your company’s future.

  • Goals, epics, and tasks
    Break down big goals into manageable work, assign tickets to the right people, and try to keep the plan together before everything goes sideways again.

  • Roles, team, and project knowledge
    Every employee brings different strengths, and the people who know the product best can make or break your momentum.

  • Office life and controlled failure
    Burnout, broken coffee machines, strange events, and constant trade-offs are all part of everyday startup life, where things rarely go according to plan.

Build your team, survive the chaos, and prove your project is more than just another disaster in the making.

data.short_description: A co-op startup management sim where you make hard decisions, argue over priorities, manage chaos, and deal with deadlines, burnout, investors, and constant pressure. Failure is expected — and every disaster is wrapped in satire and dark humor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online co-op.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online co-op.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon supported. Intel-based Macs may have limited support and performance may vary. Internet connection required for online co-op.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon recommended. Internet connection required for online co-op.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes presented in a satirical manner. It includes mild profanity, references to stress, burnout, and failure, as well as depictions of alcohol consumption in a workplace context. There is no graphic violence, sexual content, or depiction of self-harm.
